args.rationale: Dashboard and API return 503 for a whole team.

args.summary: Customer reports 503 errors on nightly pipelines and the dashboard API since about 08:40 UTC, blocking their team before a noon deadline, and says this is the second outage this month. The record shows an Enterprise customer. The SLA policy sets a 1 hour first response for Enterprise and requires immediate escalation to on-call engineering; the guideline also asks to notify the account owner.

suggested_actions.rationale: Production outage for an Enterprise customer: escalate now to meet the 1 hour SLA.
Notify the account owner as the guideline requires.
